title: Obi-Wan "Ben" Kenobi
description: OBI-WAN "BEN" KENOBI appears to be a crazy old hermit, but is really a Jedi Knight who trained Anakin Skywalker in the ways of the Force. When Anakin turned to the dark side, becoming Darth Vader, a distressed Obi-Wan left the world behind...untfl Princess Leia Organa and Luke Skywalker urgently seek his help. Obi-Wan's words and spirit give Luke strength in time of peril.
